question: In evidence.zip, Use all d99-- members in ZIP central-directory order. Read ELF e_shnum and count the corresponding section-header-table entries, including section index 0. Submit the count in base 10.

answer_format.syntax: base-10 integer with no units, separators, whitespace, or explanatory text

oracle_cmd: readelf -h gf_c_events.bin | awk -F: '/Number of section headers/{gsub(/ /,"",$2); print $2}'
